# Security policy

Report a vulnerability in Conduit, its push relay, or its server plugins
privately through
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/security/advisories/new)
on this repository's Security tab. Please do not open a public issue or
discussion for it, and do not disclose it publicly until there has been a
reasonable chance to investigate and fix it.

Include the app version, the platform, the kind of server
or connection involved, and the steps that show the problem. Leave out real
credentials, server addresses, and chat content; describe them or use invented
ones.

A problem in Open WebUI, LibreChat, Hermes, or a model provider belongs with
that project. Report it here only when Conduit's own handling is at fault.

[docs/push/THREAT_MODEL.md](../docs/push/THREAT_MODEL.md) describes what the
push notification design does and does not protect against.
